summary: A button with two parts: a main clickable action, and an attached arrow that opens a small menu of related options.
description:
The split usage mode of moz-button: `<moz-button type="split">` renders the main action button plus a second chevron button (#chevron-button) that opens a menu, so one control offers a primary action and its related options.

**Not a separate registered custom element.** It is documented separately here because it is a distinct, commonly-used configuration of moz-button; see the "button" component for the full element API.

**How the two halves split the work:** with menuId set, the MenuController attaches to the chevron, not the host: the chevron is the trigger and anchor for the panel-list, and carries aria-expanded/aria-haspopup, which the main button then omits. The chevron stops click and mousedown from propagating, so click listeners on the host hear only the main action.

**Classic predecessor:** a customized built-in registered as plain <button> (toolkit/content/widgets/button.js), where type="menu" renders a .button-menu-dropmarker fragment beside icon and label with a <menupopup> child. It still ships (historySidebar.xhtml, customizeMode.inc.xhtml and others) but is not what this entry documents. toolbarbutton.js has no split rendering branch and is not an implementation of either.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Must be exactly "split" (`isSplitButton` is `type === "split"`, and moz-button.css matches `[type="split"]` exactly), so it cannot be combined with other type words.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The main action's label; overridden by slotted content.

attributes.name: menuId
attributes.description: The ID (not a selector) of the panel-list the chevron opens; looked up as `#<menuId>`. On a split button the chevron, not the host or main button, is the menu's trigger and anchor.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Applies to both halves; at small the chevron uses the 12px arrow icon and the divider grows to 64% height.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables both the main button and the chevron.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: Optional icon on the main action; the chevron always shows its own arrow-down icon.

slots.description: The main action's content, overrides label.

events.name: click
events.description: Fired for the main action only: the chevron stops click and mousedown from propagating, and opens the menu instead.

cssProperties.name: --button-gap-split
cssProperties.description: Gap between the main action and the chevron, on the modern <moz-button type="split">.

cssProperties.name: --button-border-width-split
cssProperties.description: Border width of the inner divider between the main action and the chevron, on the modern <moz-button type="split">.

cssProperties.name: --button-split-separator-background-color
cssProperties.description: Color of the divider line between the main action and the chevron, on the modern <moz-button type="split">.

cssProperties.name: --button-split-separator-height
cssProperties.description: Height of the divider between the main action and the chevron, set on the host.

cssParts.name: button
cssParts.description: The main action's internal button background.

usage:
<moz-button type="split" label="Save" menuid="save-options"></moz-button>
<panel-list id="save-options">
  <panel-item>Save as...</panel-item>
  <panel-item>Save a copy</panel-item>
</panel-list>
